chunks: Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad ibn Ayyub ibn Shammun. He was from the noteworthy of the Shīʿa, however he did not narrate anything.

key_terms.وُجُوهِ الشِّيعَةِ: The noteworthy/prominent figures of the Shīʿa

ai.seo_question: Who was al-Qasim ibn Muhammad ibn Ayyub ibn Shammun and what is his status in Shia biographical records?
ai.summary: This entry describes al-Qasim ibn Muhammad ibn Ayyub ibn Shammun, a notable figure among the Shīʿa. Although he held a position of prominence, he is recorded as not having narrated any hadiths himself.
